summary: Whale-Weight Aquarium is a cozy physics puzzler where you swing a whale, a stretchy octopus, and a floaty jellyfish from your crane boat and settle all six friends into their aquarium tiers before the tank tips. Move with Left/Right or A/D, lengthen or shorten the line with Up/Down or W/S, press Space to drop the hook and Space again at the right swing to release — do it gently, in 12 drops or fewer, to win.
